exercises.instructionEn: Contents — Unit 1 to Unit 15, Irregular Verbs, Progress Tests
exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET — GRAMMAR BOOK'NING MUNDARIJASI.

  Kitobning 3-beti. Mashq yo'q.


⚠ WORKBOOK MUNDARIJASIDAN MUHIM FARQI:

  WORKBOOK mundarijasida unit nomlari
  MAQOL edi:
     'A Friend in Need...'
     'Birds of a Feather...'

  GRAMMAR mundarijasida esa har unitning
  GRAMMATIK MAVZULARI berilgan:
     'Subject Pronouns - The Verb "to be"
      - Indefinite Article A/An'

  ⚠ Ya'ni bu mundarija — BUTUN KITOBNING
  GRAMMATIKA DASTURI. Uni o'qib chiqsangiz,
  bir yilda nima o'rganishingizni bilasiz.


BETLAR ORALIG'I — DIQQAT:

  Ko'p unitlar 4 betdan:
     4, 8, 12, ..., 22, 26, 30, 34, 38

  ⚠ LEKIN IKKI ISTISNO BOR:

     Unit 4  — 16-21 bet (OLTI bet!)
        keyingi unit 22-betdan
     Unit 10 — 42-47 bet (OLTI bet!)
        keyingi unit 48-betdan

  Sababi: bu ikki unitda MAVZU KO'P.
     Unit 4 — olmoshlar, egalik,
        buyruq gap, Present Simple
     Unit 10 — Past Simple, artikllar,
        will, bog'lovchilar

  ⚠ Workbook'da har unit ANIQ 4 betdan
  edi — Grammar Book'da esa mavzuga qarab
  o'zgaradi.


OXIRGI IKKI QATOR:

  'Irregular Verbs   p. 68'
  'Progress Tests    p. 69'

  ⚠ Bularda UNIT raqami YO'Q — ular unit
  emas, qo'shimcha bo'limlar.

  ⚠ 'Irregular Verbs' — Coursebook'ning
  116-betida ham bor edi (111 ta fe'l).


⚠ GRAMMATIK ATAMALAR — LUG'AT:

  a subject pronoun = ega olmoshi
     (I, you, he, she, it, we, they)
  an object pronoun = to'ldiruvchi olmoshi
     (me, you, him, her, it, us, them)
  a possessive = egalik shakli
     (my, your, his, her ...)
  the possessive case = egalik kelishigi
     (John'S book)
  an article = artikl (a, an, the)
  indefinite article = noaniq artikl (a/an)
  a plural = ko'plik
  irregular plurals = noto'g'ri ko'pliklar
     (man → men)
  a preposition = predlog
     of place = joy predloglari (in, on)
     of time = vaqt predloglari (at, on, in)
     of movement = harakat predloglari
        (into, out of)
  an adverb = ravish
  adverbs of frequency = takrorlanish
     ravishlari (always, never)
  an adjective = sifat
  a countable noun = sanaladigan ot
  an uncountable noun = sanalmaydigan ot
  the imperative = buyruq gap
  linking words = bog'lovchilar
  comparisons = qiyoslash
  irregular verbs = noto'g'ri fe'llar


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  contents    = mundarija
  a syllabus  = dastur
  a topic     = mavzu
  an exception = istisno

pairs.right: Subject Pronouns - The Verb 'to be' - Indefinite Article A/An
pairs.rightUz: Ega olmoshlari - 'to be' fe'li - Noaniq artikl A/An
pairs.whyUz:
'a subject pronoun' = ega olmoshi
(I, you, he, she, it, we, they).

'indefinite article' = noaniq artikl (a/an).
⚠ 'A' undosh oldidan, 'AN' unli oldidan.

'have got' = egalik (Britaniya shakli).
'can' = qobiliyat, ruxsat.

Eng qisqa sarlavha — bu unitda faqat ikki
mavzu bor.

pairs.right: Plurals - This/These - That/Those - Some/Any - A/An - Prepositions of Place
pairs.rightUz: Ko'plik - This/These - That/Those - Some/Any - A/An - Joy predloglari
pairs.whyUz:
'plurals' = ko'plik shakllari.
'this/these' — yaqin; 'that/those' — uzoq.
'prepositions of PLACE' = joy predloglari
(in, on, under, next to).

pairs.right: Subject/Object Personal Pronouns - Possessives/The Possessive Case - Who/Whose - The Imperative - Present Simple
pairs.rightUz: Ega/to'ldiruvchi olmoshlari - Egalik - Who/Whose - Buyruq gap - Present Simple
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ ENG UZUN SARLAVHA — BESH mavzu!
Shuning uchun unit OLTI bet (16-21).

'object pronoun' = to'ldiruvchi olmoshi
(me, him, her, them).
'the possessive case' = egalik kelishigi
(John'S book).
'the imperative' = buyruq gap.

pairs.right: Adverbs of Frequency - Prepositions of Time: at, on, in
pairs.rightUz: Takrorlanish ravishlari - Vaqt predloglari: at, on, in
pairs.whyUz:
'adverbs of FREQUENCY' = takrorlanish
ravishlari (always, usually, often,
sometimes, never).

⚠ VAQT PREDLOGLARI:
AT + soat; ON + kun; IN + oy/yil.

'irregular plurals' = noto'g'ri ko'pliklar:
man → men, woman → women,
child → children, mouse → mice,
foot → feet, tooth → teeth.

Ikki zamonning TAQQOSLANISHI:

Present Continuous — hozir sodir bo'layotgan
(at the moment, now);
Present Simple — doimiy odat
(always, usually, every day).

pairs.right: Plurals - Countable/Uncountable Nouns - How Much/How Many - A Few/A Little - Some/Any
pairs.rightUz: Ko'plik - Sanaladigan/sanalmaydigan otlar - How Much/How Many - A Few/A Little - Some/Any
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Butun unit SANALADIGAN va SANALMAYDIGAN
otlar haqida:

SANALADIGAN: how MANY, a FEW
SANALMAYDIGAN: how MUCH, a LITTLE

pairs.right: Prepositions of Place - Was/Were - Had - Could
Past Simple - A/An/The - Will - Linking Words
Adjectives/Adverbs - Linking Words - Prepositions of Movement
pairs.whyUz:
'an adjective' = sifat (slow);
'an adverb' = ravish (slowLY).

'prepositions of MOVEMENT' = harakat
predloglari (into, out of, across, along).

⚠ Coursebook 114-bet: 'throw INTO the sea'.

'comparisons' = qiyoslash
(qiyosiy va ustun daraja).

⚠ 'quite' < 'very' < 'too'
('too' — SALBIY: haddan tashqari).
